name: design_voice
description: Returns up to 3 voices matching a natural language description (e.g. 'warm, confident female narrator'). Use the seed parameter to get different batches of results.

prompt.description: Natural language description of the desired voice (e.g., 'warm, confident female narrator').
prompt.title: Prompt

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag to filter by (e.g., 'en-US', 'pt-BR').
locale.title: Locale

seed.description: Controls which batch of results to return. seed=0 returns the top matches, seed=1 the next batch, etc. Same prompt + seed always returns the same voices.
seed.title: Seed
